ablation.E-G: each family alone using same frozen scores and budgets
ablation.I: valid-count-weighted mean of eligible family medians versus equal-family mean
ablation.J: per-family/stratum concentration distribution and association with rank displacement; diagnostic only

50k.label_definition: OR of retained-transaction laundering involvement; upstream raw evidence unavailable

5k.label_definition: OR of retained-transaction laundering involvement; upstream raw evidence unavailable

decision.incomplete: full-coverage E6 unavailable implies primary hypothesis inconclusive
decision.multiplicity: secondary/ablation/control results descriptive; no winner selection or significance claim
decision.support: primary full-coverage hybrid AP difference positive consistently across seeds/tiers, positive paired intervals and compatible top-K retrieval; independent validation still required

exploratory.cohort_policy: stratified random subset of the fixed held-out set, proportional class allocation; no score access
exploratory.label_use: split/cohort stratification and metrics only; never fit or select weights

intervention.cutoff: maximum retained source timestamp; full-observation involvement labels, not future-outcome labels
intervention.family_execution: separate unchanged Phase 3 engine configurations; cap two accepted per family

metrics.no_positives: AP, lift, recall and paired CI null; no zero sentinel
metrics.tie_break: descending score then Unicode lexical account ID

negative_control.compare: negative-control hybrid versus structured hybrid; report donor-change rate
negative_control.definition: permute intervened calibrated scores within family/exact count/fraction bin/amount bin; recompute deltas from recipient q0
negative_control.scope: arbitrary score placebo, not factual random omissions; same candidates/budgets/population

output_policy: new data/results/v2 directories only; completed manifests last

primary.E6_full_coverage: planned, subject to feasibility gate; never substitute cohort result
primary.split_policy: stratified entity holdout, sorted IDs; transductive full-observation graph

project_title: Machine Learning Enhanced Graph-Based Anomaly Detection for Financial Transactions

resources.failure: leave incomplete manifest/metrics absent; do not score a performance-selected partial cohort
resources.memory: RSS samples and OS peak when available; traced pilot separately

stability.model_seeds: same 250 accounts; deterministic ordinal Spearman, top-K overlap/Jaccard, displacement
stability.split_seeds: different populations; do not correlate full unmatched rankings

uncertainty.comparisons: all E6/ablation/control versus raw E4; mode versus BASE; structured versus placebo
uncertainty.limitation: graph dependence ignored; one-positive intervals omit uncertainty over positive identities
uncertainty.method: paired stratified account bootstrap, fixed observed class counts; no refits

weights.justification: prespecified quarter-scale bounded terms, not tuned
